:description: The `CALL` clause can be used to invoke a subquery or to call a procedure.
= CALL 

The `CALL` clause can be used to invoke a subquery or to call a procedure.
For more information about either of these uses, refer to:

* xref:subqueries/call-subquery.adoc[]
* xref:subqueries/subqueries-in-transactions.adoc[]
* link:{neo4j-docs-base-uri}/operations-manual/current/procedures/call-procedures[Operations Manual -> Call procedures]
